title: Whole Grain Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Ready‑to‑Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with tomato sauce is a ready‑to‑heat meal that combines whole‑grain pasta with a seasoned tomato sauce. The ingredients include whole wheat durum semolina, tomatoes, olive oil, herbs, and a modest amount of salt. The dish is designed for quick preparation in a microwave or on the stovetop.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑grain pasta provides more fiber and micronutrients than refined white pasta.
The tomato sauce is rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant that remains stable after cooking.
The meal can be prepared in 2‑3 minutes in a microwave, delivering a hot, satisfying dish.
No artificial preservatives or flavor enhancers are added.
The product is packaged in a sealed film that locks in freshness and aroma.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain pasta supplies a substantial amount of fiber, supporting healthy digestion and prolonged satiety.

items.title: Source of lycopene
items.content: Tomatoes in the sauce provide lycopene, which promotes heart health and has anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Whole grains release glucose slowly, offering steady energy levels.

items.title: Contains plant protein
items.content: The pasta contributes a moderate amount of plant‑based protein useful for tissue repair.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Prepared with a small amount of olive oil, the dish is relatively low in saturated fats.

items.title: Wheat/gluten allergy
items.content: The product contains gluten and is unsuitable for individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: People monitoring sodium intake should consider the salt level in the sauce.

items.title: Heat distribution
items.content: Microwave heating may be uneven; stir after the first minute to ensure uniform temperature.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the package in a microwave (800 W) for 2‑3 minutes, stir, and let stand for 1 minute. Optionally top with fresh herbs, grated Parmesan, or additional vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, keep refrigerated and consume within 3‑4 days.
